summary_en: DAI-DAN raised its FY2027 March interim and year-end dividend forecasts to 51 yen and 93 yen per share respectively, from 43 yen and 85 yen, following upward revisions to operating profit guidance from 36.0 billion yen to 42.0 billion yen driven by improved construction margins.
title_en: Notice regarding revision of earnings forecast and dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief:
DAI-DAN announced a revision to its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 based on upward revision of earnings projections. The company raised its consolidated operating profit forecast from 36.0 billion yen to 42.0 billion yen, a 16.7% increase, citing better-than-expected profit improvements in construction projects. The interim dividend was raised from 43 yen to 51 yen per share, and the year-end dividend from 42 yen to 51 yen per share, bringing the total annual dividend to 93 yen compared to the prior forecast of 85 yen.

The company maintains a dividend policy targeting a payout ratio of 40% or higher and a minimum DOE (dividend on equity) of 4.8%. The year-end dividend increase of 8 yen per share reflects the company's assessment that realized earnings will exceed prior forecasts, while sales revenue remains unchanged at 265.0 billion yen. The year-end dividend will be formally decided at the ordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for June 2027.
